title: Surface empty BCPT results as a warning instead of silent success
summary: When BCPT performance tests produce a results file with no entries, GetBcptSummaryMD now returns a message that appears in the GitHub step summary instead of an empty string. A missing results file still yields an empty summary.
key_points: GetBcptSummaryMD distinguishes a missing results file from one with no entries
An empty BCPT results file now produces a visible message under Performance test results
A missing results file still returns an empty string because no test was run
Pester tests added for ReadBcptFile and GetBcptSummaryMD covering missing and empty files
